page.layout: One printed page: digitiser's cover sheet with e-rara logo at top, title block, a rule, the e-rara.ch description in German, English, French and Italian, a second rule, the terms of use in four languages, and the Visual Library logo at bottom right. The cover sheet is not book text.
page.notes: The page is the digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page of the book. Per the rules, the banner, logo, link and digitiser's text are left out. The book's own title, "P. Rami dialectica" (Basileae, 1585), appears only in the cover sheet's title block and is not transcribed as main text.
